title: Continuous cocontinuous restriction as a ringed geometric inverse image
statement: Let (C,J) and (D,K) be small sites in one universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], F:C→D a continuous cocontinuous functor, and R a sheaf of possibly noncommutative rings on D. Let S be R restricted by F. There is a ringed-topos morphism f:(Sh(J),S)→(Sh(K),R) [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] whose set inverse image is exactly continuous precomposition, whose structural ring map is the identity on every section under that identification, and for which module restriction SheafOfModules.pushforward(identity S) is left adjoint to the induced f.modules. The identity assertion is a heterogeneous equality so that it also specifies the original underlying elements before transport.

proof.text: Use Mathlib Functor.sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous to obtain the set adjunction with continuous precomposition as inverse image. Sectionwise limits prove left exactness. Take the structural ring map to be the identity of the restricted ring. The generalized-element ring identities follow by evaluating at F(U). Construct the module direct image by compatible families, defining addition and the R-action coordinatewise; its underlying set sheaf is the same compatible-family direct image. Transposition along the set adjunction takes linear maps to linear maps, since its unit and counit are evaluated coordinatewise and the structural map is identity. Restrict its hom equivalence to obtain the module adjunction. The same evaluation proves additivity, the natural underlying comparison, and the module_linear field, using arbitrary rings rather than commutative rings.

lean.statement:
theorem continuous_cocontinuous_ringed_restriction
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D)
    (F : C ⥤ D) [Functor.IsContinuous F J K] [Functor.IsCocontinuous F J K]
    (R : Sheaf K RingCat.{u}) :
    ∃ f : RingedToposMorphism ((F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj R) R,
      f.inverse = F.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) J K ∧
      (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ)
        (x : (f.inverse.obj ((sheafCompose K (forget RingCat)).obj R)).obj.obj U),
        HEq (f.ringMap.hom.app U x) x) ∧
      Nonempty (SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := F)
        (𝟙 ((F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj R)) ⊣ f.modules)
